dedupe_keys.name: dutch neighbourhood household energy determinants and local coefficients 2018

description: This collection combines Dutch neighbourhood energy demand, socioeconomic attributes, building characteristics, meteorological observations and land-cover information for 2018. The producers assemble CBS, 3D BAG, KNMI, Copernicus and NASA inputs and publish geographically weighted regression estimates alongside the underlying indicators. The article describes 2,707 neighbourhoods and seventeen indicators, while the repository names nineteen determinants; the count discrepancy remains unresolved. Mendeley version 4 provides the complete release as one ZIP archive, free under CC BY 4.0. Internal file formats were not inspected. Coverage is aggregated neighbourhood context, so local regression coefficients do not establish household-level causal effects or individual gender differences. A reviewer-assessed use is constructing spatially differentiated household-energy scenarios or sensitivity ranges for building-stock simulations. model-energyplus provides a related building-energy tool, but neighbourhood indicators require assumptions to parameterize individual buildings. No spatial join, regression or archive inspection was performed.
